headline: Build a Remittance App with Afriex Business API
summary: Learn to build a remittance app using Afriex Business API
details: The Afriex Business API provides a comprehensive solution for building remittance apps. It handles complexities such as live exchange rates, recipient registration, and transfer tracking.
The API offers features like automatic retry for transient failures, webhook signature verification, and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transactions.
Developers can use the API to create a seamless remittance experience, from fetching live exchange rates to triggering transfers and handling failures.
caption:
Streamline remittance app development with Afriex Business API

The Afriex Business API provides a comprehensive solution for building remittance apps. It handles complexities such as live exchange rates, recipient registration, and transfer tracking.

The API offers features like automatic retry for transient failures, webhook signature verification, and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate transactions.

Developers can use the API to create a seamless remittance experience, from fetching live exchange rates to triggering transfers and handling failures.
